proposal: Populate APPROVED_LITERAL_SITES in tools/ui_theme.py with the sites below. Stock bytes were read from the pinned image at the stated file offsets and the immediates decoded from them; one byte string in the theme census table (palette routine accent dark) reads 4f f6 20 20 there but the image holds 4f f2 20 20, which decodes to the same 0xF220; the image bytes govern.

shared_immediates_not_sites.note: Background and foreground are not independently patchable: the palette routine loads r3 = 0xFFFF (movw at 0x030655D0) and r0 = 0 once and swaps which cell receives which per theme; the clock painter repeats the swap. A registry entry must therefore name the shared pair, not a theme.
